items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Bubber Miley was the man that was a genius at that. People give Cootie Williams credit, but Cootie apparently got it from Bubber Miley.

ctx.x: Were they using plungers much then, the trumpet players?

Yeah, Bubber Miley was the man that was a genius at that. People give Cootie Williams credit, but Cootie apparently got it from Bubber Miley. Down from New Orleans, down from the South somewhere. Those guys had natural ability. I don't know about his reading ability, but bet your life they knew that instrument they were playing. Now, --
So, now, they were playing press rolls on the snare drum. Were they playing it on the bass drum, too?
